name: Preventive Service Charged Out-of-Pocket
description: Flags claims where an Annual Wellness Visit or mandated preventive screening was billed with patient cost-sharing.
messageTemplate: This charge looks higher than what Medicare says you owe. Medicare covers Annual Wellness and preventive screenings with $0 patient responsibility.
callScript: Hi, I am calling about billing statement for my recent wellness visit. Under Medicare Part B preventive care guidelines, this service is fully covered with $0 copay. My Medicare EOB shows $0 patient responsibility. Could you please re-bill this to Medicare or adjust my account balance?

name: Patient Amount Exceeds Medicare EOB Stated Owed
description: Flags bills where the provider's invoice exceeds the patient responsibility determined on the Medicare Explanation of Benefits.
messageTemplate: Your provider's bill is higher than what Medicare says you owe on your Explanation of Benefits.
callScript: Hello, I received a bill for ${{billedAmount}}, but my official Medicare Explanation of Benefits lists my patient responsibility as ${{eobAmount}}. Participating Medicare providers cannot bill more than Medicare's allowed amount. Could you please correct the balance?

name: Potential Duplicate Charge on Same Date
description: Flags identical procedure codes billed twice on the exact same date by the same medical provider.
messageTemplate: We detected two identical charges on the same date from the same provider. This may be an accidental duplicate billing.
callScript: Hello, I am reviewing my statement and noticed the procedure code {{procedureCode}} appears twice on {{serviceDate}} for the same visit. Can you verify if this was an accidental duplicate entry?
